instruction: Design the main gameplay screen (a single page) for a polished offline dinosaur runner inspired by the familiar browser game. Include a side-view running dinosaur, layered desert ground, cacti and a flying obstacle, score and high-score HUD, a small speed indicator, and a clear jump instruction. Put strong emphasis on crisp silhouette readability, rhythmic spacing, a distinctive modern-retro identity, and a coherent, highly polished composition rather than a bare clone.

history.critique: The artifact fails significantly on Brief & Intent Alignment: it presents a UI shell rather than a gameplay screen. The 'side-view running dinosaur' is reduced to an unrecognizable cyan pixel blob; 'layered desert ground' is a single flat line; and 'cacti/flying obstacles' are entirely absent. Clarity & Information Hierarchy is compromised by the massive central 'NEON RUNNER' title, which dominates the viewport and obscures the actual game area, while the HUD elements (Score, Best, Speed) are scattered with inconsistent visual weights. history.suggestion: 1. **Rebuild the Game World:** Replace the single line with a multi-layered parallax background using CSS gradients or SVG patterns to create a 'layered desert' (distant dunes, mid-ground texture, foreground ground). 2. **Inject Core Assets:** Create a recognizable pixel-art dinosaur (using CSS box-shadows or a small SVG) and add at least one cactus and one flying obstacle to demonstrate the runner mechanic. 3. **Restructure HUD:** Consolidate the top bar. Group 'Score' and 'High Score' on the left with a unified font. Move 'Speed' to the right but make it legible. Remove the giant central title from the gameplay view (or fade it significantly) to prioritize the action. 4. **Unify Visual System:** Select a single typeface (e.g., a clean monospace or pixel font) for all UI text to resolve the typographic clash. Apply the 'neon' aesthetic to the game elements (e.g., glowing cacti, horizon line) to bridge the 'modern-retro' gap while fulfilling the 'desert' requirement.
